items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: But Kenny Clarke and I hung out mostly in Paris.

ctx.x: Who did you hang out with up there? Who was up there mostly?

Well, Kenny Clarke. And I would go up there with Dizzy; sometimes we'd go up and play. And I had the chops in the range, so I had no problem as with what they would play. But I didn't know the tunes.
